Feldman ORCID: orcid.org/0000-0003-2288-5017 1 , 2 Nature Water volume 4 , pages 1375–1377 ( 2026 ) Cite this article Save article View saved research 113 Accesses Metrics details Water innovations such as desalination, wastewater reuse and rainwater harvesting can do more than strengthen water security. International cooperation is needed to ensure that these technologies promote equitable benefit-sharing, mobilize investment and reduce tensions in regions where climate stress and water scarcity threaten stability.
